names.note: The calendar’s own name page for him is «Александр (Шкляев), протоиерей, сщмч.»; the grade and the rank are stripped and the surname kept, the day line itself giving only «… и Александра пресвитеров». `fk.mjs` on the stored string returns NONE.

death.note: The year the day line closes with, «(1918)», which is the whole of what the source gives; no year of birth anywhere.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 10 декабря ст. ст. — «Сщмчч. Иакова и Александра пресвитеров, сщмч. Евграфа пресвитера и сына его мч. Михаила (1918).»

attestations.note: The second of the four one line enumerates, and THE LINE AND THE NAME PAGES ARE ALL THERE IS. The line says «пресвитеров» and his name page «протоиерей», archpriest, so `presbyter` is the line’s word and the office `Archpriest` the name page’s. `new-martyr` is written as this corpus writes it for this calendar’s twentieth-century «сщмч.» entries. No folder held him: a Cyrillic grep for «Шкляев» over every `saint.json` returns nothing. The day page prints eleven hymns and none is under any of these names.
